name: Joe AI
positioning: AI conversational agent that answers, qualifies and follows up with callers for real estate agencies, networks, syndics and developers, 24/7.
description: Joe AI is a French AI conversational agent for real estate professionals. It answers, qualifies and follows up with clients across calls, SMS, email and WhatsApp, with a customisable human-sounding voice, for agencies, networks, syndics and developers. The editor states more than 500 clients and hosts the service in France and the EU under GDPR, with no data shared between clients and no training of its models on client conversations.
description_fr: Joe AI est un agent conversationnel IA français pour les professionnels de l'immobilier. Il répond, qualifie et relance les clients sur les appels, SMS, email et WhatsApp, avec une voix personnalisable à consonance humaine, pour les agences, réseaux, syndics et promoteurs. L'éditeur déclare plus de 500 clients et héberge le service en France et dans l'UE sous RGPD, sans partage de données entre clients ni entraînement de ses modèles sur les conversations clients.
real_estate_use: An agency or syndic receiving a high volume of routine calls — visit requests, general questions, recurring tenant demands — needs those calls answered and pre-qualified around the clock without adding reception staff. Joe AI takes the first contact across phone, SMS, email and WhatsApp, qualifies and routes it, and leaves human teams the advisory, signing and follow-up work.
features: Multi-channel support: calls, SMS, email, WhatsApp
France/EU hosting, GDPR-compliant, no cross-client data sharing

use_cases.job: Answer and pre-qualify incoming calls and messages 24/7 before handing qualified leads to an agent
Handle recurring occupant calls automatically and route what needs a human

capabilities: AI voice and conversational agent that answers, qualifies and follows up with real estate callers across calls, SMS, email and WhatsApp
